collection.title: Hyundai ix55 2008 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Hyundai ix55 2008 to 2012 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
